title: Partner / Cloud Marketplace weekly sync — prep & action items
content:
Agenda (30m)
- Quick status round (5m) — Samir (AWS), Mei (GCP), Oliver (Azure)
- Integration blockers & rollout risks (10m)
  - AWS: marketplace listing review outstanding (legal/comms sign-off)
  - GCP: quota & billing test failing for sandbox customers (token timeout)
  - Azure: partner onboarding doc needs updated schema for VPC/private deployments
- Metrics review (5m) — conversion funnel from listing -> trial -> dedicated request
- Next-step alignment & owners (10m)

Prep notes / highlights
- AWS:
  - Listing draft ready, waiting on legal for two clauses re: data residency. Contact: Laura (legal).
  - Action: push small wording change to Confluence page and loop legal.
  - Status: GA-ready except legal sign-off and final logo assets.
- GCP:
  - Billing sandbox failing for accounts created with promo codes — appears related to billing account linkage required during onboarding.
  - Regression introduced by last billing SDK bump (see GH PR #87).
  - Action: Mei to coordinate with infra and billing eng to run repro and provide a remediation plan.
- Azure:
  - Partner onboarding doc (internal) doesn’t include new key rotation steps for Private deployments.
  - Action: Oliver to produce updated doc + checklist by EOD Thu.

Metrics snapshot (to reference in call)
- Listings: AWS (4 active), GCP (3 active), Azure (2 active)
- Trials started this month: 18 (AWS 8, GCP 6, Azure 4)
- Dedicated capacity requests: 3 (AWS 2, GCP 1)
- Avg time from listing -> trial: 6.2 days
- Conversion to paid/procurement: 11% (target 18%)

Risks / open questions
- Legal delay on AWS listing could block a set of enterprise leads with region constraints. Contingency: ship listing with limited region set + notice. (Laura owns decision)
- Billing SDK regression: do we revert or patch? Need eng cost estimate for patch vs revert fragility. (Mei to get estimate)
- Do we surface dedicated vs hosted differences more clearly on marketplace listing pages? Product/marketing input needed.

Action items (owners + due dates)
- Jamie: update Confluence listing draft with legal-friendly phrasing and attach latest logo assets. Due: 2026-03-24.
- Laura (Legal): review listing clauses and confirm if limited-region launch acceptable. Due: 2026-03-25.
- Mei (GCP): triage billing sandbox failure, reproduce, and propose patch/revert plan; include effort estimate. Due: 2026-03-24.
- Oliver (Azure): update partner onboarding doc with key rotation + checklist and add screenshots. Due: 2026-03-26.
- Samir (AWS): confirm final image assets and test listing in staging marketplace. Due: 2026-03-24.
- Product (cc: Priya): propose copy changes for marketplace listing to better explain Dedicated vs Hosted. Due: 2026-03-27.

Follow-up / next sync
- Weekly sync: Tue 2026-03-30 10:00am PT (30m) — focus on legal sign-off & billing fix status.
- Send a 1-paragraph update to channel after this sync summarizing decisions and ETA for fixes. (Jamie)

Notes to self (scratchpad)
- Pull latest conversion funnel numbers from GA + Zendesk to validate the 11% conversion stat before the call.
- Prep 1 slide summarizing "critical path" for marketplace launches (legal, billing, assets, onboarding).
- Consider adding a short FAQ for marketplace listings to reduce legal back-and-forth.

References / links for discussion
- Confluence: Cloud Marketplace Program (see linked_artifacts)
- GH PR: marketplace-integration PR #87 (billing SDK bump)
- Jira: JIRA-5821 (marketplace listing legal review)
- Slack thread: #partners-marketplace (context + customer asks)

Unresolved / parking lot
- Pricing alignment discussion with sales ops (defer to next week).
- Need a standardized checklist for marketplace private deployment onboarding (owning team: solutions engineering).

Quick TL;DR to paste in calendar invite
- Goal: unblock marketplace listings and triage billing regression affecting GCP sandbox. Owners assigned for legal, billing, onboarding docs. Weekly follow-up Tue 3/30.
